+import os
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+PRE_PUSH_HOOK = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "hooks" / "pre-push"
+
+
+def _git(cwd, *args, input=None):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        ["git", *args], cwd=cwd, input=input, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
+    ).stdout.strip()
+
+
+def _init_repo(tmp_path):
+    repo = tmp_path / "target"
+    repo.mkdir()
+    _git(repo, "init", "-q")
+    _git(repo, "config", "user.email", "test@example.com")
+    _git(repo, "config", "user.name", "Test")
+    (repo / "README.md").write_text("init\n")
+    _git(repo, "add", "README.md")
+    _git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", "init")
+    return repo
+
+
+def _commit_adding_file(repo, parent_sha, filename, content):
+    blob_sha = _git(repo, "hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", input=content)
+    ls_tree = _git(repo, "ls-tree", parent_sha)
+    entry = f"100644 blob {blob_sha}\t{filename}\n"
+    mktree_input = (ls_tree + "\n" if ls_tree else "") + entry
+    tree_sha = _git(repo, "mktree", input=mktree_input)
+    return _git(repo, "commit-tree", tree_sha, "-p", parent_sha, "-m", "add file")
+
+
+def _run_pre_push(repo, stdin_text):
+    env = dict(os.environ)
+    env["AI_GOVERNANCE_FRAMEWORK_ROOT"] = str(REPO_ROOT)
+    return subprocess.run(
+        ["bash", str(PRE_PUSH_HOOK)],
+        cwd=repo, input=stdin_text, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env,
+    )
+
+
+def test_version_bump_advisory_counts_pushed_branch_not_head(tmp_path):
+    repo = _init_repo(tmp_path)
+    head_sha = _git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
+    pushed_sha = _commit_adding_file(repo, head_sha, "added_file.txt", "hello\n")
+    assert _git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == head_sha
+
+    stdin_text = f"refs/heads/feature {pushed_sha} refs/heads/feature {head_sha}\n"
+    result = _run_pre_push(repo, stdin_text)
+
+    assert "changed_files=" in result.stdout, f"stdout={result.stdout!r} stderr={result.stderr!r} rc={result.returncode}"
+    line = next(l for l in result.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith("changed_files="))
+    changed_files = int(line.split("=", 1)[1])
+    assert changed_files >= 1
